evals.name: three-tier-web
evals.prompt: Create a draw.io architecture diagram for a standard three-tier web application on AWS. It runs in us-east-1, has two AZs, an ALB in public subnets routing to EC2 app servers in private subnets, and an RDS Multi-AZ database in isolated subnets. Add CloudFront in front of the ALB and Route53 for DNS.
evals.expected_output: Valid .drawio file with CloudFront, Route53, ALB, 2x EC2, RDS Multi-AZ, correct VPC/subnet containers, postLayout set to verticalHierarchical, all services using mxgraph.aws4 shapes

assertions.check: run validate_drawio.py and exit code is 0

assertions.description: mxCell id=0 and id=1 are present
All service shapes use mxgraph.aws4 namespace

assertions.check: postLayout attribute present on mxGraphModel element

assertions.description: CloudFront, Route53, ALB, EC2, RDS all appear as vertices
assertions.check: grep for each service name in value attributes

assertions.description: Public and private subnet containers present

assertions.check: two mxCells with group_availability_zone grIcon present

assertions.description: All edge source/target IDs exist as vertices

evals.name: serverless-api
evals.prompt: Diagram a serverless API on AWS: Route53 → API Gateway → Lambda → DynamoDB, with S3 for static assets served via CloudFront, and Cognito for auth. Keep it simple, no VPC needed.
evals.expected_output: Valid .drawio file with 7 services, correct mxgraph.aws4 shapes, no VPC containers (serverless), postLayout set, edges showing request flow with labels

assertions.check: run validate_drawio.py and exit code is 0

assertions.description: All service shapes use mxgraph.aws4 namespace
Route53, API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront, Cognito all present

evals.name: eks-microservices
evals.prompt: Create an EKS-based microservices architecture diagram. Two node groups in private subnets across 3 AZs. ALB Ingress Controller in public subnet. Services: EKS cluster, ECR for images, RDS Aurora PostgreSQL, ElastiCache Redis, MSK for event streaming. Add CodePipeline → CodeBuild → ECR CI/CD path outside the VPC.
evals.expected_output: Valid .drawio file with EKS group container, 3 AZs, correct node placement, CI/CD path shown separately, 10+ service nodes

assertions.description: EKS, ECR, RDS, ElastiCache, MSK, ALB, CodePipeline, CodeBuild present

evals.name: data-pipeline
evals.prompt: Draw an AWS data pipeline: Kinesis Data Streams ingesting from IoT devices, Lambda processing function, S3 data lake, Glue crawlers and jobs, Athena for queries, and QuickSight for visualization. Add CloudWatch for monitoring.
evals.expected_output: Valid .drawio file with left-to-right flow, horizontalHierarchical postLayout, correct service shapes, data flow arrows

assertions.description: Kinesis, Lambda, S3, Glue, Athena, CloudWatch present

assertions.check: edge cells with source and target

evals.name: multi-account-landing-zone
evals.prompt: Diagram an AWS multi-account landing zone. Show: Management account at the top with AWS Organizations and Control Tower. Three member accounts: Security (GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config), Shared Services (Transit Gateway, Route53 Resolver, Directory Service), and a Workload account (VPC with app tier). Show connectivity via Transit Gateway.
evals.expected_output: Valid .drawio file with account boundary containers, Transit Gateway as hub, correct account grouping

assertions.description: Organizations, Control Tower, GuardDuty, Transit Gateway, Directory Service present

assertions.check: Transit Gateway vertex with multiple edges

evals.name: bedrock-rag
evals.prompt: I need a diagram for a RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) architecture on AWS using Bedrock. User query comes in via API Gateway, Lambda orchestrates: query goes to OpenSearch Serverless for vector search, retrieved chunks plus query go to Bedrock (Claude model) for generation, response cached in ElastiCache, conversation history in DynamoDB.
evals.expected_output: Valid .drawio file with Bedrock shape (mxgraph.aws4.bedrock), correct data flow, all 7 services present

assertions.description: API Gateway, Lambda, OpenSearch, Bedrock, ElastiCache, DynamoDB present
